attention_cue: The grey band stops wandering and turns to face you together, edging into a loose ring at the rim of your light — behaviour, not markers.
entry_transition: The world outside the ring dims and desaturates as the simulation pauses; the camera's focus tightens on you and the band; your flame brightens once, like an intake of breath.
visual_hierarchy: your flame and its glow band

signal_map.flame steadiness: the flame's corona: warm gold when inside the band, searing white when too bright, ember-dim when failing
signal_map.nomad commitment: posture — leaning in, shielding eyes, or turning away; kneeling on commitment
signal_map.encounter progress: the ring's radius visibly tightening toward you

feedback_win: The ring closes; the kneelers saturate to warm gold in one slow wave.
feedback_fail: A white flash or a gutter to ash; the ring breaks outward and the fog takes the leavers.
exit_transition: The dimmed world breathes back to full color and the simulation resumes; the flame settles to its ordinary size.
